$comment: Machine-readable form of docs/license-policy.md (R-029). A test asserts the two agree. GUARDRAIL FILE.

approvals.decision: Approve all 12 with the stated conditions through 2027-09-16.
conditions: no npm package, binary, desktop bundle, or redistributable build is published
CI verifies exact package versions and scopes against the ledger
any distribution plan, material dependency change, or expired review date blocks release and requires new review

exceptions.use: Automated accessibility scanning in the Playwright a11y gate.
exceptions.linkage: Dev-only test tooling. Never imported by shipped code, never bundled.
exceptions.noAlternative: axe-core is the de facto engine for automated WCAG checks; no permissively licensed equivalent of comparable coverage exists.
exceptions.obligations: MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft on modification. The files are unmodified and not distributed.
exceptions.replacementCost: Lose `pnpm test:a11y`. D-037 and R-007 both require automated accessibility checks.

exceptions.linkage: Dev-only tooling in the secret-scanning gate. Unmodified, never bundled.
exceptions.obligations: WTFPL imposes no conditions. Recorded because it is not on the R-029 allowlist, not because it creates an obligation.
exceptions.replacementCost: Lose `pnpm test:secrets`, the only secret gate that runs on every contributor machine. D-037 requires secret scanning.
Same as @axe-core/playwright: lose the accessibility gate.

exceptions.obligations: Artistic-2.0 is OSI-approved and permissive for unmodified use. Unmodified, not distributed.
exceptions.replacementCost: Lose `pnpm test:secrets`, the only secret gate that runs on every contributor machine. D-037 requires secret scanning.

exceptions.use: Browser-support data table, a hard dependency of next@16 for target resolution.
exceptions.linkage: Build-time data. Consumed by the compiler; the dataset is not emitted into the client bundle.
exceptions.noAlternative: Non-optional transitive dependency of Next.js. Not selectable, not replaceable without replacing Next.js.
exceptions.obligations: Attribution if the dataset is redistributed. Nothing is redistributed: the product is a privately hosted server application.
exceptions.replacementCost: Replacing Next.js. This is the only runtime-scope exception remaining.
